Detection_Logic: Amplitude event name has no match in Tracking_Event_Standards
Recommended_Action: Review and map legitimate aliases; retire meaningless events.

Issue: Documented active event has no Amplitude activity
Detection_Logic: Active governed event has zero observed events
Recommended_Action: Validate implementation; confirm event is still required.

Detection_Logic: Same Tracking_ID appears more than once
Recommended_Action: Assign unique IDs and deduplicate tracking log.

Detection_Logic: Raw tracking name differs from canonical event name
Recommended_Action: Adopt canonical snake_case naming and alias map.

Detection_Logic: Deprecated governed event continues to appear in Amplitude
Recommended_Action: Remove old instrumentation or update implementation.
Correct source values or extend approved mapping.

Detection_Logic: Same user/session/event observed within one second
Recommended_Action: Investigate duplicate listener or repeated firing.

Detection_Logic: Event timestamp exceeds project as-of date
Recommended_Action: Correct client/server clock or timestamp parsing.
